coverage.policy: Conceptual c/v pairs counted once; occurrence coverage uses positive native count keys only

limitations: Saved bodies can differ from GDELT's original body
Set scoring ignores offsets and repeated mentions
Amount scoring requires matching numeric value and normalized object
GCAM scores cover declared implemented dimensions only
Value errors require a native value and local matches; native companion counts are checked when present
Missing native weighted match counts are unreported, not measured zeros; they are excluded from count errors
Dimension and occurrence coverage measure computable keys, independently of matching agreement
Family correlations require at least 20 native-positive articles; WAPE divides absolute count error by native counts
A sample-size limit selects record IDs in order and is not source-balanced

sample.policy: Published source vocabularies and fixed native mappings; Affect direct-label policy selected on development count WAPE only; no benchmark fitting or selection
sample.benchmark_history: Previously evaluated for other fields and earlier GCAM profiles; no expansion revision selected from benchmark outputs

wordnet-lexical-3.1.sense_policy: union of all senses; each occurrence counted once per category

wordnet-affect-1.1.sense_policy: union of annotated senses; direct labels

wordnet-domains-3.2.sense_policy: union of annotated senses; no unannotated parent propagation

gkg-themes.matching: unique matched spans per category; overlapping spans retained; document context guards preserved
